description: Literature reference values for the Phase 8 half-Heusler validation set (phase8.md §8). Each non-null value carries a DOI that was resolved via Crossref and checked against the paper text or abstract. confidence: A = value in that paper's own data, B = quoted from a cited primary source not read, C = approximate (figure/text approximation). kind 'total' means total thermal conductivity, not kappa_l (electronic part small for undoped samples, not verified). Null values are unverified; see notes.

lattice_constant_angstrom.note: arc-melted, SPS, annealed 1073 K 1 week polycrystal (Table 1, 0.6110 nm); a Ni-rich Sn-flux crystal gives 6.1033(2) A (Fu et al., Adv. Sci. 2020, doi:10.1002/advs.201902409)

band_gap_pbe_ev.note: QE + ONCV, PBE; character from Raghuvanshi et al., J. Mater. Chem. A (2020), doi:10.1039/D0TA06810A (PBE: VBM Gamma, CBM X)

kappa_l_300k_w_mk.note: undoped, room temperature (Table 2); measured kappa_l is strongly sample-dependent (~10 down to <5 W/m/K with Ni excess / fine grains)

zt_peak.citation: Chauhan et al., ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces (2019)
zt_peak.note: Hf-free ZrNi1.03Sn; Hf-alloyed record: Zr0.75Hf0.25NiSn0.99Sb0.01 ZT 1.33 at 873 K (Ai et al., Nat. Commun. 2025, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-61868-x)

lattice_constant_angstrom.citation: Holuj et al., Phys. Rev. B 92, 125436 (2015)
lattice_constant_angstrom.note: bulk value quoted from Jeitschko, Metall. Trans. 1, 3159 (1970), doi:10.1007/BF03038432 (primary not read)

band_gap_pbe_ev.note: QE + ONCV, PBE; character from Raghuvanshi et al., J. Mater. Chem. A (2020), doi:10.1039/D0TA06810A (PBE: VBM Gamma, CBM X)

kappa_l_300k_w_mk.note: no verified single value; only a second-hand range of 6.7-10 W/m/K total kappa (Holuj 2015 citing Uher et al., PRB 59, 8615 (1999))

zt_peak.citation: Joshi et al., Adv. Energy Mater. (2011)

lattice_constant_angstrom.note: solid-state + hot pressed, Rietveld (Table 1); 5.926 A extrapolated without interstitial Ni

band_gap_pbe_ev.note: QE + ONCV, PBE; also 0.45 eV PBE in Zahedifar & Kratzer, PRB 97, 035204 (2018); character from Raghuvanshi et al., J. Mater. Chem. A (2020), doi:10.1039/D0TA06810A (PBE: VBM Gamma, CBM X)

kappa_l_300k_w_mk.note: at 323 K, kappa - L T/rho; 88 % dense sample without porosity correction (likely low)

lattice_constant_angstrom.citation: Tian et al., J. Appl. Phys. (2020)
lattice_constant_angstrom.note: experimental value quoted from Tian et al., PCCP 20, 21960 (2018), doi:10.1039/C8CP04287J (primary not read); also 5.95 A in Zeeshan et al., PRMaterials 2, 065407 (2018)

band_gap_pbe_ev.note: QE PBE, no SOC; other codes 0.54-0.55 eV (Tian et al., Mater. Today Phys. 2021, doi:10.1016/j.mtphys.2020.100278)

kappa_l_300k_w_mk.note: TOTAL kappa of undoped NbFeSb at room temperature (data in Suppl. Fig. 8); ~17 W/m/K quoted elsewhere (Zhu et al., Nat. Commun. 2018)

lattice_constant_angstrom.note: arc-melted, room-temperature XRD, small CoZr2/Zr impurities

band_gap_pbe_ev.note: WIEN2k PBE at relaxed a = 6.0912 A; character from VBM at L (Zhu et al. 2018, Duan et al. 2026), CBM location not verified - least solid gap entry

kappa_l_300k_w_mk.note: TOTAL kappa of undoped ZrCoSb at room temperature, quoted from He et al., Mater. Today Phys. 1, 24 (2017), doi:10.1016/j.mtphys.2017.05.002

zt_peak.citation: Duan et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. (2026)
zt_peak.note: Co-deficient, Sn-doped, Hf-alloyed ZrCoSb (exact formula not in abstract); ZrCoBi family: 1.42 at 973 K (Zhu et al., Nat. Commun. 2018)
